Anya (Docs): quick ask 111 - I want to add a short JS snippet showing microBatch + kvPrefetch + q4 profile for the Optimize SDK. Planning to land as an "examples/optimize/js/shortseq.md" patch. Thoughts?

Ravi (SDK): yes please. Keep it Node-first (not browser). Use the new names: microBatch, kvPrefetch, quantProfile. Also show both promise and stream variant if space allows.

Jules (ML): add a one-liner about hardware compatibility: q4 prefers A100/T4 and may use fp16 fallback on CPU/offload configs.

Anya (Docs): draft snippet (promise):
```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/optimize');
const client = new OptimizeClient();
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwkv-7b',
  prompt: 'Summarize:',
  maxTokens: 64,
  microBatch: 6,
  kvPrefetch: true,
  quantProfile: 'q4_0'
});
console.log(resp.outputText);
```
Is that good?

Ravi (SDK): looks good. tiny rename: outputText -> text in v1.2.0. Also include error handling for ModuleNotFound in CI snippet-tests.

Anya (Docs): updated snippet -> `text`. Adding compact stream example as well:
```js
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'rwkv-7b', prompt: 'Continue:', microBatch: 4, kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_0' });
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```

Marta (PM): can we include a short migration note: "old param names: batchSize, prefetchKv" so customers searching for legacy docs find it?

Anya (Docs): yes adding a migration anchor and redirect. Also adding a tiny table recommending microBatch sizes for targets: interactive (1-4), conv (4-12), throughput (12+).

Anya (Docs): switching to require('@redwood/optimize-client') and pushing. Also adding instruction in CONTRIBUTING.md about the test env package names.

ci-bot: rerun checks. snippet-tests passed. md-lint: warning line 45 long-line (85 chars) - reduced. link-check: broken link found to /optimize/qprofiles (404).

Anya (Docs): fixed link to /optimize/quant-profiles and shortened the long line. Pushing final commit.

ci-bot: All checks passed. Merging PR via squash.

Marta (PM): awesome. Please add the doc URL to the release notes and the SDK changelog.

Ravi (SDK): will note the param renames in SDK release notes and a small code-mod script in tools/upgrade-scripts/update_opt_params.sh

Jules (ML): I'll drop a follow-up email to platform@ about telemetry for quantProfile usage so we can monitor q4 uptake.

Anya (Docs): Published: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/js-shortseq-microbatch. Closing thread, thanks all :sparkles:
